jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

As the Finance Manager, you will oversee the FP&A half of Coram's Finance function, which includes he financial forecast of the business, the analysis that sits around it, and the reporting that tells the leadership team where we actually are against plan. 


Responsibilities:

 - Oversee the company financial model and the forecast: building it, maintaining it, and defending it

 - Regular reporting on actuals versus plan, with early flags when something is drifting

 - The explanation behind the numbers. Why revenue moved, why spend landed where it did, what it means for the next two quarters

 - Cross-functional depth across sales, marketing, R&D and finance. You need to understand what each team is actually doing and how that shows up in the numbers

 - The analysis leadership uses to make decisions: headcount, spend, pricing, planning cycles



Skills and qualifications:

 - 5–10 years of relevant, hands-on experience

 - SaaS operating experience with deep understand of how the model behaves

 - Significant ownership experience:  a model, a forecast, or a P&L line, with a clear story about the impact it had on the business

 - Experience within rapidly scaling organizations. Early stage is a plus 

 - Strong business acumen and very high attention to detail

 - Fluency in your own work with the ability to walk through a complex model you built and talk credibly about forecast accuracy

 - Exposure to fundraising is a plus

 - Exposure to the go-to-market side of the business is a plus

 - Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

 - Ability to work in an onsite environment



What we offer:

 - Competitive compensation package

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses

 - Free onsite EV charging

 - Daily team dinners and regular team off-sites

 - The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. 



Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.




THE ROLE:


As a Senior Strategy & Operations Manager, you’ll report directly to the leader of Strategy & Operations and lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that shape how Coram scales its go-to-market organization. You’ll identify business challenges, define priorities, and build and lead workstreams from initial problem framing through implementation, adoption, and measurable results.


This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You’ll partner with senior stakeholders across sales, marketing, finance, and leadership to solve ambiguous problems, improve critical GTM processes, and build the systems and automation that support our next stage of growth.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Independently define and lead strategic GTM work-streams end-to-end, establishing objectives, scope, success metrics, execution plans, and accountability

 - Solve complex GTM challenges by combining data analysis, stakeholder input, and business judgment to identify root causes and recommend practical solutions

 - Partner with senior stakeholders to align on priorities, navigate tradeoffs, secure decisions, and drive execution across teams

 - Design and scale processes and systems that improve revenue team productivity, operational visibility, and the customer journey

 - Build and deploy AI agents and automations that reduce manual work and improve the speed and quality of GTM execution

 - Lead implementation and change management, ensuring new processes and tools are adopted, maintained, and delivering their intended impact

 - Anticipate risks, resolve dependencies, and keep cross-functional initiatives moving in a fast-paced environment

 - Communicate clear recommendations, progress, and results to leadership, connecting operational improvements to business outcomes




SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 5–7 years of experience in strategy & operations, revenue/sales operations, business operations, or a related field, with meaningful experience at a B2B technology company

 - Demonstrated ability to create and lead complex, cross-functional workstreams from an ambiguous starting point through implementation and measurable results

 - Experience partnering with senior stakeholders, influencing decisions without formal authority, and building alignment across competing priorities

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced spreadsheet fluency and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations

 - Strong understanding of GTM motions, revenue processes, and the operational challenges of scaling a B2B organization

 - Experience designing and implementing tools, systems, and processes that teams adopt and rely on

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools and building agents or automations to improve business workflows

 - Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce, including CRM architecture, workflows, data quality, reporting, and best practices

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex issues into clear recommendations for senior audiences

 - Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to prioritize independently and balance long-term improvements with immediate business needs

 - Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities

 - Current or recent experience at a high-growth, Series A–C company is a plus

 - BA/BS degree required; MBA preferred

 - Able to work onsite





WHAT WE OFFER:

 - 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

 - Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

 - 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

 - Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

 - Referral bonuses

 - Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off-sites

 - The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

jobs.title: Sales Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.



You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.



The role:

We’re looking for a Sales Onboarding Program Manager to own and evolve the programs that help our sellers ramp faster and perform at a higher level.



Reporting directly to our Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, you will own the coordination and delivery of Sales onboarding end to end: managing cohorts, facilitators, certifications, communications, readiness tracking, and the overall new-hire experience. As we continue to scale, you’ll build the systems and processes that allow us to onboard sellers frequently while maintaining a consistently high bar for customer readiness.



Beyond onboarding, you will design and execute high-impact sales programs across our outbound-heavy sales motion, helping sellers become stronger at prospecting, pipeline generation, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression. You’ll also support enablement across Coram’s growing channel motion, helping ensure sellers understand how to effectively work with and through partners.



You’ll leverage AI, seller performance data, and field insights to identify opportunities, measure program effectiveness, and connect enablement programs to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional GTM teams to align programs to the highest-priority business needs.




Responsibilities:

 - Own Sales onboarding from pre-boarding through ramp, including scheduling, facilitation, SME coordination, certifications, communications, and follow-up

 - Coordinate and deliver frequent onboarding cohorts as the Sales organization continues to grow rapidly

 - Track seller readiness and ramp progress, giving managers clear visibility into where reps are excelling and where additional coaching or support is needed

 - Continuously improve onboarding based on seller performance, manager feedback, new-hire feedback, and evolving business priorities

 - Build programs that strengthen Coram’s outbound sales motion, including prospecting, pipeline generation, cold calling, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression

 - Build and support enablement programs that help sellers effectively navigate Coram’s channel and partner motion

 - Partner with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and top-performing sellers to turn what works in the field into scalable, repeatable plays

 - Define clear success metrics before programs launch and measure impact beyond attendance or completion

 - Use sales data and AI-powered insights to identify performance gaps, prioritize enablement opportunities, and assess program effectiveness

 - Build scalable processes, playbooks, certifications, and operating rhythms that allow Coram to maintain a high performance bar as the organization grows

 - Facilitate live training, workshops, certifications, and field programs for sellers and sales leaders

 - Travel periodically for onboarding, team events, field enablement, and other company or Sales organization programs
   
   

Success metrics:

 - New hires become customer-ready and productive faster, even as onboarding cohorts increase in frequency and size

 - Managers have clear visibility into rep readiness, ramp progress, and areas requiring coaching

 - Sellers consistently execute the behaviors required to generate high-quality outbound pipeline

 - Sales programs drive measurable improvements in seller behavior, pipeline creation, and revenue performance

 - Sellers are equipped to effectively leverage Coram’s direct and channel motions

 - Best practices from top performers become repeatable across the field

 - Enablement programs are measured by business impact, not activity alone

 - Coram can continue scaling its Sales organization without sacrificing onboarding quality or seller readiness




Skills and qualifications:

 - 3–5 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Programs, Revenue Enablement, Sales Strategy, or a related GTM role

 - Experience owning or supporting B2B SaaS sales onboarding in a high-growth environment

 - Experience supporting an outbound-focused sales organization and a strong understanding of modern prospecting and pipeline-generation motions

 - Strong program management, facilitation, and cross-functional leadership skills

 - Ability to use sales data to identify performance gaps and measure program impact

 - Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle, from prospecting through close

 - Comfortable facilitating live sessions and working directly with sellers and sales leaders

 - Comfortable building programs and processes while the organization, product, and go-to-market motion are evolving quickly

 - Willingness to travel periodically based on onboarding, field, and company needs

 - Experience with channel or partner-led sales motions is a plus

 - Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

 - Ability to work in an onsite environment
